title: Docker Compose — Web
description: Docker Compose × Web integration. Owns the web service overlays (deploy/compose/compose.web.yaml and compose.web.dev.yaml) that the Compose roots include when the web frontend is deployed with Compose. Hidden: it activates automatically when both docker-compose and tanstack-start are effective, and selecting it directly is shorthand for that pair. Template-only; delivered through the Git source.
